name: While Loop Challenge — Cyber Rover Harvester
description: Lesson 17 — Master Python while-loop challenges with the Cyber Rover Harvester. 20 exercises: while recap, harvesting loops, debugging, missions, and comment-guided runs.

labels.collect: scoops a glowing energy crystal into the rover's cargo bay
labels.drill: activates the sonic laser drill to break down crystal geodes
labels.scan: emits a sweeping radar pulse to analyze planetary terrain
labels.beacon: fires the orbital light beacon to signal mission complete!
labels.print: outputs telemetry data and counter status to console

legend: 🤖 crystals = 0 start counter · while crystals < 3: loop while True · crystals = crystals + 1 step counter · Click stage buttons to test rover systems!
idleText: Cyber Rover Lumina-9 is on standby. Write while loops to harvest crystals and deploy the beacon!
userIdea: While Loop Challenge: students experience using python while loops from following the command to inserting their own conditions and commands, with smooth interactive graphics and visual condition understanding
